description: List knowledge gaps. Questions the AI could not answer well, flagged by the gap detector with the customer message, the AI reply, a canonical form of the question, and a suggested answer and target. Open gaps by default; status=all for everything. Read-only: fix a gap with POST /knowledge/faqs or by editing identity.instructions, and dismiss it in the portal.

channel.description: Channel the question came in on.

starting_after.description: The next_cursor from the previous page.

status.description: Default open. Use all for every status.

name: list_knowledge_gaps
